purpose: Machine-readable rules for the AI-first pyprefix migration: full repo-wide migration must be deterministic, scoped to owned Python source, package-sized, proof-gated, and contract-aware.

rules.rule: Repo-wide scans and migrations must exclude virtualenvs, _reference, archive, generated dist/site/artifacts, data, caches, and assistant scratch directories.
Do not apply a broad whole-repo codemod. Migrate one package or bounded slice, dry-run first, then apply and run the full proof gate.
compile() verifies syntax only; scripts/run_proofs.py is the runtime oracle after every applied package migration.
A path may enter architecture/pyprefix_migration.json migrated only after pyprefix check reports 0 violations and the full proof gate is green.
getattr/setattr/hasattr, globals/locals, eval/exec, importlib.import_module, string dispatch, and JSON/string-key surfaces are unresolved risk until a deterministic rewrite proves otherwise.

Args with keyword or **kwargs callers, protocol/interface methods, dataclass fields, class attributes, constructor keywords, and string-key surfaces must be migrated with all their callers/implementers/surfaces as one contract.

Names required by external runtimes or specs, such as CLI main, test discovery names, template run(inputs), API serve/handle, and framework hooks, must be preserved only as exempt compatibility wrappers that delegate to typed implementations.
Identifier uniqueness must live in meaningful py_<kind>_<file>__<scope>__<name> names, not hashes or opaque IDs.
